title: What we’re building at Tuturuuu
intro: Every product, milestone and deliverable, with what has shipped and what’s next. Statuses come straight from public pull requests and live deploy checks.

shipped.title: Shipped this week
shipped.subtitle: Deliverables merged in the last 7 days. “Live” means the production deploy already contains the change.
shipped.empty: Nothing merged in the last 7 days yet.
shipped.moreHint: Feature pull requests merged this week, straight from GitHub.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.subtitle: Each area’s milestones and deliverables. Tap a milestone to see every item.

item.unverified: Merged; the deploy can’t be verified publicly yet
item.notOnWorkers: Merged; app is not served from Workers yet
item.nextRelease: Merged; ships in the next app release

hosting.title: Where each app runs
hosting.subtitle: Live probe of each app’s public build-info endpoint, compared with the latest commit on main.

method.title: How statuses are computed
method.live: Every pull request is merged and the app’s production deploy is at or after the merge.
method.waiting_for_prod_sync: Merged on main; production doesn’t contain it yet, or the deploy can’t be verified.
method.waiting_for_merge: The pull request is open, ready for review and approved.
method.in_progress: An open pull request, or work we have started without a public PR yet.
method.planned: On the plan. No claims until there is public evidence.
method.sources: Sources: public GitHub pull requests in tutur3u/platform and each app’s public /api/build-info. The page refreshes in your browser every 10 minutes.

footer: Public roadmap. No private operational data. Dates are in Vietnam time (UTC+7).
